Khador the Rowdy

Overview

A former warrior under Gort, Khador fell out with his commander and now welcomes the chance to fight beside Zak. His eagerness for battle is more prominent than any grand cause. He stays associated with the village and warns that a crowded party would get in the way of his axe. [1, 2, 3]

Recruitment and farewell

Khador, usually called Rowdy, served under Gort and was once his friend. After an episode involving mushrooms and an outspoken quarrel, the two stopped speaking. Free of his former duties, Rowdy offers Zak his axe and enthusiasm for a fight. His recruitment is optional, and other business can temporarily keep him in the village. When Zak leaves Gipath alone, Rowdy accepts the farewell and hopes he will return safely. [1, 4, 3, 5, 2, 6, 7]
